quirks.lineage: Menu skeleton identical to hummod_3.0.4 (Stop=6, Go 12-30, Trauma/Hemorrhage=741); verified by engine_smoke with the 3.0.4 profile. Full Daily-Planner aerobics experiment (manual 3.4) completed 2026-11-05 via the 3.0.4 profile with zero code changes.
quirks.slider_note: DailyPlanner/Control Aerobics Level slider commits (ctrl 9836, ordinal 2; raw pos x 10 = Watts, 30 reps; pos 5 -> 50 W verified via snapshot). Aerobics Duration = ordinal 3 (12 reps x 5 min, default 30). Verify every slider via snapshot; some other sliders on this build do not commit.
quirks.options_dialog: Options menu (id 8) opens modal 'HumMod - Options' (Reset | Restart tab). UPPER Apply id=10 'Reset the model and solver to their original states' = factory reset: revives dead subjects AND reverts UI settings to XML factory values. LOWER Apply id=20 'Move current values to initial conditions' = Reset-Keep: clock -> 0, ALL current values (UI settings AND current physiology, including a corpse state) become the new ICs; does NOT revive. Apply buttons keep the dialog open; press via hummod_dismiss_modal(prefer=id), close via 关闭 id=1. Menu Restart (id 7) re-reads the last-established ICs (factory XML ICs on a fresh process).
quirks.daily_planner: Panels: Lifestyle/Daily Planner/Schedule (id 624) = 24 rows x 5 radios (Sleep/Rest/Work/Aerobics/Eat Meal = values 0-4, left to right); Aerobics radio of hour h (0-based, 12AM-1AM = h=0) = ordinal 5*h+3 among 120 radios. Lifestyle/Daily Planner/Control (id 623): Switch radio ordinals 0=Off/1=Start Now/2=Start At Midnight; AerobicsLevel default 100 W; AerobicsDuration default 30 min. Probe vars: DailyPlannerSchedule.Hour12AM-1AM ... Hour11PM-12AM, DailyPlannerControl.Switch/Status/Task, Status.Exertion/Activity/Posture/Nutrition.
quirks.heat_pinned: This build pins core and skeletal-muscle temperature: HeatCore and HeatSkeletalMuscle define Change = Gain-Loss then override <def> Change = 0, and define Temp(K)=Mass/(...) then override Temp(K)=310/310.15. HeatCore.Temp(C) stays exactly 37.0, SweatGland.H2ORate stays 0 even at 227 W total exercise watts; total body water falls only ~30-50 mL/h (insensible+urine). Aerobic-exercise deaths on BAT are muscle-acidosis -> skeletal+respiratory muscle failure -> circulatory collapse (autopsy Dehydration=0), NOT water loss.
quirks.planner_aerobics_no_wrapup: Exercise-Control.Wrapup exits immediately when Request == NO_EXERCISE (0); Daily-Planner aerobics never sets Exercise-Control.Request, so the exhaustion auto-stop (muscle pH <= Motivation 6.65, muscle/resp failure, coma) does NOT fire for planner-driven aerobics. Bouts end only by AerobicsDuration timer; the subject keeps exercising every hour until the acidosis death cascade (on 50 W/30-min bouts: pH crosses 6.65 in bout 4 ~t=205 min, death ~210-215 min).
quirks.death_handler: On death the engine forces DailyPlannerControl Switch->0 and Status->0 (planner radio shows Off after death). Agonal state: MAP ~8-10, CO 0, HR 160-200, SkeletalMuscle-Ph.Ph ~4.15, Brain-Function.Effect ~0, Autopsy-Examination.IsDead=1.
quirks.six_hour_go: Go 6 Hours takes ~100-170 s wall solving (vs ~3-4 s per 1 Hour step) and the subject still dies (DPAerobics reaches 50 at end; last bout had 1.9 min left at t=360) - the manual's 'engine ignores aerobics in the second half' recovery does NOT happen on BAT. One observed run CRASHED the engine process (CPU frozen ~164 s then process gone); an identical retry completed - crash is non-deterministic. Restart engine + reconfigure after a crash; UI-set parms are memory-only and lost.
quirks.bind_transient: Right after hummod_start, page navigation/radio can fail once with 'page did not finish loading' while the model binds; retry succeeds.
quirks.epo_computed: BAT COMPUTES EPO (unlike 3.0.4 where the manual lists it as missing): Structure\EPO\ is included, secretion driven by Right/LeftKidney-TubuleO2 tubular pO2 (Tau 20 min filter). Read EPOPool.[EPO] (mU/mL) or EPOPool.[EPO(pG/mL)] (= mU/mL x 7.69). Verified 2026-11-05: baseline 18.1 mU/mL -> 51.7 at 1 day / 33.0 at 1 month at 10000 ft (R2 experiment 4.3.5).
quirks.environment_altitude_slider: Lifestyle/Environment Altitude slider COMMITS on BAT (unlike 3.0.4): ctrl 10342, ordinal 0 of 5 sliders. Repeatlist 20 reps x 500 ft + 30 reps x 1000 ft -> pos p<=20 = p*500 ft, p>20 = 10000+(p-20)*1000 ft (max 40000 ft, pos 50). Verified pos 10/20/25/30/35/40/45 -> 5000/10000/15000/20000/25000/30000/35000 ft via Altitude.Feet snapshot; Barometer.Pressure = 760*exp(-4e-5*Feet) updates instantly (no Go needed for static readings). XML <parm> Altitude.Feet injection remains the fallback.
quirks.long_go_rest: At rest, long Go steps are safe on BAT: Go 1 Day ~25 s wall, Go 1 Week ~40 s wall completed without crash or Math Error at 10000 ft (30-day continuous run, R2). The non-deterministic crash risk R1 saw was under 6-Hour Go with heavy planner aerobics; still prefer 1 Day/1 Week chunks for month-scale runs and re-verify the clock (System.X) after each chunk.
quirks.treadmill: Lifestyle/Exercise/Treadmill sliders COMMIT: Speed (ctrl 10464, ordinal 0 of 3; repeatlist 30 reps x 0.5 MPH -> pos = 2*MPH), Grade (ctrl 10469, ordinal 1; 15 reps x 1% -> pos = grade%), Efficiency (ctrl 10490, ordinal 2; 99 reps x 1%). Start exercise via Lifestyle/Exercise/Control radios (3: 0=Resting, 1=Exercise Bike, 2=Treadmill; probe Exercise-Control.Request/Status.Exertion). PREREQUISITE: subject must be Standing - set Lifestyle/Posture/Posture Request radio (8 radios on page; ordinals 5=Lying/6=Sitting/7=Standing of PostureControl.Request; probe Status.Standing) or the Request is silently rejected (onjustchanged guard 'Request EQ REQUEST_TREADMILL AND NOT Status.Standing').
quirks.treadmill_exhaustion: UNLIKE daily-planner aerobics (no wrapup), treadmill bouts DO auto-stop: Exercise-Control Wrapup fires when SkeletalMuscle-Ph.Ph <= Motivation parm (default 0.04 slider = min muscle pH 6.65) and resets Request->0/Status.Exertion->0 mid-Go (clock keeps advancing). At 10000 ft, 6 MPH flat already exhausts the subject within one 5-min stage (muscle pH 6.76 after stage 1). Repeated bouts stack the acid load: after 4 consecutive bouts (0/0/2/4%) the 6% bout drove muscle pH 6.39 -> skeletal+respiratory muscle failure -> circulatory collapse -> death (IsDead=1, GCS 3, CO 0, MAP 7.5, HR 202 agonal) ~10 min after the last bout, same cascade as the R1 aerobics death. Record bout duration until auto-stop as the tolerance metric and do NOT chain bouts without recovery.
quirks.posture_page: Lifestyle/Posture/Posture (NOT Posture/Control - that resolves to a Diet page) has 8 radios: ordinals 0-4 = Restraint (None/Lying/Sitting/Standing/Tilting), ordinals 5-7 = PostureControl.Request (Lying/Sitting/Standing). Radios carry no check state; probe Status.Posture (1=lying,2=sitting,3=standing)/Status.Standing.
quirks.menu_paths: Panel paths that differ from the menu tree labels: Lifestyle/Posture/Posture (posture controls), Lifestyle/Exercise/Treadmill + /Control (submenu leaves), Lifestyle/Environment hosts Altitude+Barometer+Temperature+Humidity+Wind+Clothes on ONE page (no Altitude subpage).
quirks.status_bar_progress: While solving, the status bar shows 'Solving ...' then '... Done'; on this build the Stop menu item becomes ENABLED during the run. hummod_busy may report busy=false mid-run because the UI thread stays responsive - trust the status text.

Lifestyle/Daily Planner/Schedule.values: Sleep=0 Rest=1 Work=2 Aerobics=3 EatMeal=4 (column order); Aerobics of hour h = ordinal 5*h+3
